notes.title: Online Coop using Parsec
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9403452/4f554d382df3c71fc545123de3c245b39868ea22.jpg[/img]

Hi,

Playing [b]Tachyon Project[/b] co-operatively can be a lot of fun but you need to have your friend at home with you to play it. That's ideal but not always the case.

Thanks to the wonderful people at [b]Parsec[/b] it's now possible to play [b]Tachyon Project[/b] online co-op. They have developed a free tool that makes this possible and it works pretty well! Parsec basically lets you stream a game, and have friends watch and play along with their own controllers... ok keyboard (but who plays a twin-stick shooter with the keyboard and the mouse, right? ;) ).

The app is not only free, but very easy to set up and use:

[olist]
[*] Download the client from [url=http://parsecgaming.com]http://parsecgaming.com[/url].
[*] Run the app and create an account. Your friends need to do the same.
[*] If you want to host the party, click "Add A Computer", and use your own computer or rent a cloud computer from Parsec.
[*] To join a friend who's hosting, add them using their Parsec username, and request to Co-Play.
[*] The host can now run Tachyon Project and the rest will be able to play as if they were sitting next to them!
[/olist]

If you have any issues with Parsec, jump on over to their Discord [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/cQjEGFy]here[/url].

Cheers,
Eduardo
